name: Decanter of Endless Ale
body:
Aura moderate transmutation; CL 9th; Slot none; Price 18,000 gp; Weight 2 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

If the stopper is removed from this ornate flask and a command word spoken, an amount of fine ale pours out. Separate command words determine the quality of ale as well as the volume.

“Rotgut” pours out 1 flagon of poor quality ale per round.
“Nice” produces a mug of good quality, highly intoxicating ale once every 10 minutes
“Party” produces a gallon of medium quality, sweet ale once every minute.

The ale will last for 1 hour if poured into a container (avoiding a great mess!). The decanter may be used at will, but will stop pouring after 10 consecutive rounds.

It must then recharge for 1 hour and may then resume.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item, Spells control water, Special creator must possess 5 ranks in Craft (brewing); Cost 9,000 gp
